annotations.text: Multi-league foundation (sub-project #1). Model (a): connect a provider once -> pick which of your leagues to track -> land in the league view. A persistent switcher (top of artboard 3) moves between tracked leagues; each keeps its own scoring, roster rules and redraft/dynasty flag.

The league view is ONE screen that adapts to the live draft status. Drafted -> Season mode (shown here): a placeholder that names what #2-#7 build in. Not yet drafted -> the existing draft board below, no change.

Drafting branch - Auction.dc.html / Snake.dc.html are UNCHANGED. Inside the new shell they render under the same switcher header. A league flips from its board to Season mode on its own the moment its live draft status reads 'complete' - decided from the live board poll, not a stored field.
